title: Desanā
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || || Tatra || voca || || 3 Valāhakakāyike bhikkhave deve desissāmi || taṃ suṇātha || || 4 Katame ca bhikkhave valāhakakāyikā devā || || Santi bhikkhave sītavalāhakādevā || santi uṇhavalāhakā devā || santi abbhavalāhakā devā || santi vātavalāhakā devā || santi vassavalāhakā devā || || 5 Ime vuccanti bhikkhave valāhakakāyikā devā ti || ||
